name: Doornik-207
description: Doornik-207 was a planet located witnin the Koornacht Cluster in the Core Worlds. The planet was colonized by the Corasgh, settled under the Galactic Empire. However, it was wiped out by the Yevetha during the Great Purge, whereupon the Yevetha colonized the world.
